name: Curated entity block
description: Blocks where an editor hand-picks and orders existing entities, rendered in one view mode.
project_description:
Provides blocks where an editor hand-picks and orders existing content

entities and renders them in one chosen view mode (typically a teaser

variant). A site builder defines the selectable pool and the allowed view

modes through a View, so it's nicely configurable. 

 Features: 
 
 The same block type can be reused for many curation scenarios: "featured articles", "editor's picks", a hand-sorted spotlight, and so on. 
 Define multiple curated blocky by configuring multiple Views. 
 Restrict selectable view-modes, min-max limits and allowed-steps (e.g. 3-6-9) in the Views-configuration. 
 If the custom elements module is installed, it allows rendering picked entities via the module. 
 Generated blocks work nicely with Drupal Canvas. That way the module brings flexible entity-reference selection to Canvas pages. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 Please refer to the "Site-builder setup" section in the README.

 Additional Requirements 
 
 Views module 
 
 Recommended modules/libraries 
 The module integrates well with:

 
 Drupal Canvas 
 Lupus Decoupled / Custom Elements
